title: Navigating by the stars
summary: Build a star fix from first principles: the sky's clock (Julian date, sidereal time), where a star stands, latitude from Polaris, a star detector in OpenCV, plate solving, the camera's direction from the IMU, the two latitude roots and the prior that chooses — and why one degree of attitude costs 111 km. You write NAVERA Lite's star part on six synthetic night photos.
